apiVersion: vmoperator.vmware.com/v1alpha1
kind: VirtualMachine
metadata:
  name: ns4-vm1
  namespace: ns4
  labels:
    vm-selector: ns4-vm1
    vm-lb-o5d5: vm-lb-selector
spec:
  className: best-effort-xsmall
  imageName: vmi-b8d6a5cb9dc109b9c
  storageClass: vsan-default-storage-policy
  powerState: poweredOn
  vmMetadata:
    secretName: ns4-vm1-bootstrap-secret
    transport: CloudInit
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: Secret
metadata:
  name: ns4-vm1-bootstrap-secret
  namespace: ns4
  labels:
    vm-selector: ns4-vm1
stringData:
  user-data: |
        #cloud-config
        users:
          - default

        ssh_pwauth: True

        chpasswd:
          list: |
            ubuntu:my_new_password
          expire: False

        hostname: ns4-vm1

        write_files:
          - content: |
              #!/bin/bash
              #
              # apt install
              #
              apt update
              apt install -y jq
              packages='["apache2"]'
              echo $packages | jq -c -r .[] | while read package
              do
                apt install -y $package
              done
              #
              # Apache
              #
              my_ip=$(ip -j -c -r a | jq '.[] | select(.ifindex == 2).addr_info[0].local')
              mv /var/www/html/index.html /var/www/html/index.html.old
              echo -e "Hello World - Version 1.0 - Node is $(hostname) - IP is ${my_ip}" | sudo tee /var/www/html/index.html
              #
              # End of cloud init
              #
              echo "cloud init done" | tee /tmp/cloudInitDone.log
            path: /opt/bootstrap.sh
            permissions: 0755

          - content: |
              ubuntu ALL=(ALL) NOPASSWD:ALL
            path: /etc/sudoers.d/ubuntu

        runcmd:
          - /opt/bootstrap.sh

  ssh-public-keys: |
    ssh-rsa  ubuntu@nic-vsphere-nsx-avi-gw
---
apiVersion: vmoperator.vmware.com/v1alpha1
kind: VirtualMachineService
metadata:
  name: vm-lb-o5d5
  namespace: ns4
spec:
  selector:
    vm-lb-o5d5: vm-lb-selector
  type: LoadBalancer
  ports:
    - name: http
      protocol: TCP
      port: 80
      targetPort: 80
